subject: Edge Telemetry Adapter addition - compliance check & rollback plan
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@netmetrics.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: New edge telemetry adapter we plan to enable for Redwood - quick compliance packet

Hi Alex,

Hope you're well — quick heads-up from NetMetrics: we've built a light-weight "edge telemetry adapter" that batches and forwards anonymized observability events from regional gateways to our analytics cluster. We believe it will improve tail-latency diagnostics for customers using dedicated/dedicated-edge routes.

We want to add Redwood as an early adopter and need to be added to your subprocessors roster for telemetry processing. Attached is a short security sheet and a draft DPA amendment to cover the change. Can you point me to the person on your side who handles subprocessor intake? Also, are there any export/residency checks we should run for EU-hosted tenants?

Attachments: netmetrics_adapter_security_sheet.xlsx (summary), dpa_amendment_draft.pdf (redline)

Thanks,
Ethan
Head of Integrations, NetMetrics
Ops: ops-team@netmetrics.io

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@netmetrics.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New edge telemetry adapter we plan to enable for Redwood - quick compliance packet

Thanks Ethan — looping in Legal (Kimberly), Privacy (Naomi) and Security (Rishi) for intake.

Quick answers:
- Please share a one-page diagram showing data flow for EU tenants specifically (what leaves the region if anything).
- We require a DPA amendment and a processor questionnaire (SOC2 or equivalent evidence).
- For initial onboarding we prefer a canary rollout and a quick rollback plan in case customers report data locality regressions.

Kimberly/Naomi/Rishi — can you confirm required artifacts and an acceptable review window? I can coordinate a short call with the NetMetrics team if that helps.

Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@netmetrics.io>
Date: 2026-12-07T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New edge telemetry adapter we plan to enable for Redwood - quick compliance packet

Thanks Alex. Ethan — thank you for the materials. I reviewed the redline at a glance; we will need the following as part of subprocessor onboarding for EU tenants:

Required items (minimum):
- Signed DPA amendment (DocuSign link preferred)
- Processor questionnaire + recent SOC2 Type II report or equivalent
- Data flow diagram that calls out pseudonymization/anonymization steps and retention periods
- Confirmation of encryption in transit and at rest (keys and KMS region)
- A rollback/kill-switch procedure and SLAs for deletion on customer request

Operational constraints we typically enforce:
- No persistent storage of raw request payloads for EU tenants; 7-day rolling buffer max unless customer opts in 
- All telemetry derived identifiers must be one-way hashed before export outside EU region

Please provide the diagram and SOC2 by EOD Friday (2026-12-10) so we can complete the intake by next week. If NetMetrics requires additional terms, send a redline of the DPA amendment to legal-notices@redwoodinference.com.

Naomi/Rishi — please add any technical checks (eg. egress IP list, KMS regions) you need.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@netmetrics.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New edge telemetry adapter we plan to enable for Redwood - quick compliance packet

Appreciate the checklist — attaching the diagram and our latest SOC2 summary plus the security sheet you requested. We enforce AES-256 at rest and TLS1.3 in transit; KMS keys are customer-segmented in eu-west-1 for EU tenants. Retention defaults to 7 days, can be shortened.

Attachments: netmetrics_adapter_security_sheet.xlsx, netmetrics_dataflow_eu.pdf, netmetrics_soc2_overview.pdf

Proposed rollout:
- Week 0: DocuSign DPA amendment execution (we can send the link)
- Week 1: Limited canary (5 tenants) in eu-west-1 with strict retention and monitoring
- Week 2: Expand to additional customers after a short evaluation window or earlier if rollback is triggered

Rollback/kill-switch: service flag + immediate deletion API that returns deletion receipts. We can provide logs for deletion events.

Let us know when you want the DocuSign envelope — sending now if that speeds things up.

Ethan

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@netmetrics.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New edge telemetry adapter we plan to enable for Redwood - compliance gating and canary schedule

All — good packet, thanks. Naomi/Rishi: confirm that the attached SOC2 summary + adapter security sheet meet minimal evidence; if yes we'll accept the canary under the following conditions before live routing to any EU customer:

Action items/conditions (summary):
1) Legal: execute DPA amendment via DocuSign (Ethan — send envelope to legal-notices@redwoodinference.com).
2) Privacy: NetMetrics provides the one-page EU dataflow (attached) and confirms hashing/pseudonymization step is applied pre-export.
3) Security: Rishi to receive egress IPs and KMS region confirmation (rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com).
4) Ops/Eng: Canary limited to 5 customers; rollback flag and deletion API must be live and tested in staging; Redwood to run a simulated deletion test before Week 1 cutover.
5) Communications: We will notify impacted tenants 72 hours before enabling the adapter and provide the opt-out route.

If Legal and Security greenlight the DocuSign and Rishi gets the IP/KMS confirmations by EOD Monday (2026-12-13T17:00:00-08:00) Alex will schedule the Week 1 canary for 2026-12-20.

Please include any additional redlines to the DPA amendment in the DocuSign comments. Ethan — once I have the envelope link I'll route to Kimberly for signature.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: netmetrics_dataflow_eu.pdf; netmetrics_adapter_security_sheet.xlsx
